{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Grand_Hall_of_the_Traders_Guild.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Self-Constructing Armament Factory was installed in the Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild by the Techno Union.]]
The '''Self-Constructing Armament Factory''' was an automated production facility design made by [[Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies/Legends|Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies]],<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> an [[Utapau/Legends|Utapauan]] company.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|259|Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies}}</ref> They utilized local materials,<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> expanding by building their own facilities and maintaining themselves, slowly consumng the available space around them with no consideration for their surroundings. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], led the occupation of Utapau, he did so backed by the forces of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. The corporation added the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to their portfolio,<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile2014|12|TEC 1-2|Techno Union Starfighter}}</ref> with Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies becoming a Techno Union design firm.<ref name="General Grievous' starfighter">{{DB|starship|grievousfighter|starfighter, General Grievous'}}</ref> Grievous ordered the construction of Self-Constructing Armament Factories to build [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], vehicles, and war machinery using Utapau's raw materials.<ref name="Terror on Wheels">{{FigurineCite|24|Spaceships and Vehicles}}</ref> Techno Union [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] installed one of these automated production faciltiies<ref name="Fact File" /> in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City's]] ancient [[Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild/Legends|Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild]] with no regard for the planet's architectual heriage. If left undisturbed, they would have turned Utapau into a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] riddled with ugly refineries and assembly lines, trembling under the weight of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] war machines.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />
